description: Active public Meta ads worldwide (plus EU/UK/BR and political archives) from one static binary — zero browser, zero API key required, plus local SQLite competitive intelligence.

novel_features.name: Winner & longevity leaderboard
novel_features.description: Rank active ads by proven longevity (days running), collation scale, and platform breadth.

novel_features.name: Advertiser snapshot diff
novel_features.description: See exactly which ads an advertiser launched, stopped, or scaled between timestamped snapshots.

novel_features.name: Side-by-side competitor benchmark
novel_features.description: Benchmark multiple advertisers side by side on active volume, median age, format mix, platforms, CTAs, and refresh velocity.

novel_features.name: Landing page & funnel mapper
novel_features.description: Group active ads by unwrapped destination domain, URL path, and UTM parameters including carousel cards.

novel_features.name: EU/UK/Political transparency & beneficiary audit
novel_features.description: Roll up EU/UK/BR reach, age-gender breakdowns, beneficiary/payer pairs, spend brackets, and violation flags per advertiser or byline.

novel_features.name: Keyword share-of-voice leaderboard
novel_features.description: Rank which advertisers dominate a category keyword by active ad count, collation-weighted volume, dominant format, and median longevity.

novel_features.name: Creative hook & copy pattern teardown
novel_features.description: Extract, deduplicate, and rank opening copy hooks, headlines, and CTAs weighted by collation count and longevity.
